profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has a policy to pay dividend at a rate of not less than 50% of net profit (separate financial statements) after deducting all types of reserves required by law and Articles of Association. The Board of Directors ("the Board") will consider approving the dividend payment by taking the utmost benefits of shareholders into account, as long as such dividend payment do not significantly impact the Company's normal operation. However, the dividend payment maybe subject to change, depending on the operating performances and financial positions, financial liquidity, business expansion plans, necessity and other suitability in the future, and other factors related to the Company's management as the Board and/or shareholders deem appropriate.
